§30.5 Functions of the Second Kind

ⓘ
Defines:
𝖰𝗌nm⁡(x,γ2): spheroidal wave function of the second kind
Keywords:
definitions, of the second kind, spheroidal wave functions
Notes:
See Meixner and Schäfke (1954, §3.6).
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/30.5
See also:
Annotations for Ch.30

Other solutions of (30.2.1) with μ=m, λ=λnm⁡(γ2), and z=x are

30.5.1 𝖰𝗌nm⁡(x,γ2),
n=m,m+1,m+2,….
ⓘ
